title: 第23章 系统暴击肉身力量蹭蹭飙升第24章 抵达敦煌城打包出售
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 眨眼间，苏长歌便走出了黑松林。
但感知中，背后有一道若有若无的气息在跟踪自己。
“狼心狗肺！”
他骂了一声，但也不是很在意。
想跟就跟吧，反正你也活不长了。
他不露声色，继续前行，就像根本不知道后面有人一样。
而后方，美妇躲藏在灌木丛中，眼珠骨溜溜的转，紧紧跟上。
“我一定要把那宝刀拿到手！”
她给自己打气，袖子中有一把暗箭，准备伺机动手。
突然，前方的苏长歌停下脚步。
原因无他。
脑海中，系统的补贴到账了！
【你送出了一颗幽魂碧冥灵丹，百亿补贴生效，触发超量暴击！
【本次超量暴击倍数：三十六万两千九百倍！
【恭喜宿主获得：大力九转丹！
大力九转丹？
名字怎么这么粗糙？
摇摇头，苏长歌不知怎么了，突然就想到了大力水手。
那夸张的肩膀肌肉，蕴含着英雄般的力量……
所以，莫非吃了此物，自己的肉身力量就能大量增加？
果然，系统声音响起。
【系统提示：天级丹药，内含汹涌磅礴的巨力，一颗下肚，可增长一百万斤力量！
“卧槽！”
饶是苏长歌，也忍不住眉毛一跳。
一颗丹药，直接增加百万级力量？
要不要这么暴力？
惊讶之后，便是无尽的欣喜。
那屠龙刀重达百万斤，自己这一颗丹药吃下去，那拿起它还不跟健身球一样玩？
百万斤的东西当健身球玩。
脑海刚闪过这个念头，苏长歌就绷不住了，道：“沃日，牛逼！”
“实在是牛逼！”
旋即，他将大力九转丹取出，没有浪费时间，一口吞服了下去。
“轰咔！”
丹药入口，苏长歌顿时感到一股雄厚到极点、磅礴到极点的力量在自己体内扩散，以迅猛的速度，灌注进体内根根筋骨，以及条条经脉当中，强横非常！
“咔嗤！”
一声脆响，经脉被撑的满满的，足足胀大了一倍，仿佛里面蕴含着无尽的力量！
不止这一条经脉。
浑身其他的经脉，同样是被灌注的鼓胀起来，胀大了一圈！
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, Su Changge walked out of the black pine forest.
But in his perception, there was a vague aura following him behind him.
"Wolf-hearted and dog-lunged!"
He cursed, but didn't really care.
Follow me if you want, you won't live long anyway.
He kept moving forward without revealing anything, as if he didn't even know there was anyone behind him.
Behind, the beautiful woman was hiding in the bushes, her eyes darting around, and she followed closely.
"I must get that sword!"
She cheered herself up and had a hidden arrow in her sleeve, ready to make her move.
Suddenly, Su Changge in front stopped.
There is no other reason.
In my mind, the system’s subsidy has arrived!
【bite!
[You sent a ghost jade pill, tens of billions of subsidies took effect, triggering a super critical hit!
[This super critical hit multiplier: 362,900 times!
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining: the powerful nine-turn pill!
The powerful nine-turn elixir?
Why is the name so rough?
Shaking his head, Su Changge didn't know why, but suddenly thought of Popeye.
Those exaggerated shoulder muscles contain heroic power...
So, could it be that if you eat this thing, your physical strength will be greatly increased?
Sure enough, the system sound sounded.
[System prompt: Heaven-level elixir contains surging and majestic strength. One pill can increase your strength by one million kilograms!
"Fuck!"
Even Su Changge couldn't help but twitch his eyebrows.
A pill directly increases strength by a million levels?
Do you want to be so violent?
After the surprise, there was endless joy.
That Dragon-Slaying Knife weighs a million kilograms. If I take this elixir, how about picking it up and playing with it like a fitness ball?
A million pounds of stuff is used as a fitness ball.
As soon as this thought flashed through his mind, Su Changge couldn't hold himself any longer and said, "Wori, you're awesome!"
"It's really awesome!"
Immediately, he took out the powerful nine-turn pill and swallowed it in one gulp without wasting time.
"Boom!"
After entering the elixir, Su Changge suddenly felt an extremely strong and majestic power spreading in his body, pouring into every muscle, bone, and meridians in his body at a rapid speed. It was extremely powerful!
"Kachi!"
With a crisp sound, the meridians were fully stretched and doubled in size, as if they contained endless power!
It’s not just this one meridian.
The other meridians throughout the body were also swollen by the infusion, and they swelled in a circle!
title_en: Chapter 23 System critical attack and physical strength soaring Chapter 24 Arriving at Dunhuang City to package and sell
